messages:
sre-bot: [ALERT] autoscaler: sustained queue_depth + token-rate anomaly · service=inference-runtime · queue_depth=980 · tokens/sec=1.9x baseline · throttle_events=22 · paging @lina

sre-bot: Incident logged: INC-2026-1192 · severity=high · link: https://incident.internal/INC-2026-1192

lina: oncall here. quick check: dashboards show steady token bursts from a clustered IP range, spikes in 10s windows. taking lead.

derek: joining. looks like client-side retry storms every ~15s; batching amplifies queue.

ash: support reporting timeouts from a few customers. add customer-impact flag.

lina: immediate mitigations I want to try: 1) add temporary IP-prefix rate-limit at edge for suspect prefix 2) increase autoscale surge target (allow extra replicas for 10m) 3) silence queue_depth alert signature while we validate to avoid repeated paging.

derek: applied rate-limit: edge rule -> path '/v1/completions' limit 12r/s per ip for prefix 203.0.113.0/24. verifying now.

lina: applied autoscale: surge_capacity +15% for 12m, scale_out.cooldown reduced to speed up, scale_in.lockout set to 6m.

ops-bot: config change recorded by derek at 2026-03-12T02:37:19Z

derek: immediate effect: tokens/sec reduced ~52% for that prefix in 90s. queue_depth trending down to ~260. throttle_events drop noted.

lina: muting queue_depth alert for 25m and adding an alert annotation 'muted-during-mitigation' so oncall handoffs see rationale.

ash: leaving a brief support note: 'We are throttling a burst that impacts some non-enterprise traffic; engineers are mitigating.'

lina: we still need to reduce future noise and prevent overreactive scaling. post-incident proposed actions: - add a 3-5m rolling median to queue_depth evaluation to ignore microbursts - introduce a per-client tokens/sec anomaly detector that triggers a low-severity alert and suggestions for edge throttling - add post-scale cooldown of 4m to avoid flip-flopping - dashboard widget for 'top token producers' with owner contact info

derek: also recommend an automated canary: simulate 2x sustained tokens/sec for 6 minutes in staging to validate autoscale thresholds.

ops-bot: follow-up ticket created: INF-4610 · 'Alert hysteresis + per-client token anomaly + staging canary' (assignee=derek)

lina: capturing runbook edits now. patch will include the edge-throttle play, exact commands, rollback steps, and when to mute alerts vs. leave running.

ash: FYI I contacted the owning customer on the IP range; they acknowledged a load test hit their integration. they will pause/review.

derek: reverting temporary surge capacity in 20m if metrics stay healthy. leaving a short window in case of rebound.

lina: handing off in 25m to next oncall. notes in the incident: mitigation applied, customer reached, ticket INF-4610 opened, alerts to retune.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-1192 status -> monitoring

lina: end of thread.
